title: Starship Landing Lab
description: I’d love a game where you build and tune the autopilot that lands a starship. Adjust how it responds to speed, tilt, and drift, then watch it attempt a landing. If it overshoots the pad, tips over, or hits the ground too hard, use the flight data to figure out what to tweak before the next run. The goal is a soft, upright touchdown on the landing pad.
author: Jochen
